source_observation: One combined turning pair. Johnny steps in a wide stance, hat and bearded face left of mermaid's torso looking up-right at her; his arms cradle her waist and upper back. Mermaid is upper-right with head turned left/down toward him but hair swings across face so no invented clear front-facing eyes; cyan band visible above. Her near arm crosses downward in front to hold his shoulder while her far arm loops behind his neck. Long green tail curls across his waist toward left and sharply rises into vertical fin at upper-left. White curved water-motion strokes behind fin. Preserve the paired contact and continuous limb anatomy.
